correctness.rationale: Reconstructed every normalization and equality stratum. Exact rational checker recomputes 60 Caratheodory-envelope Bernstein coefficients, proves the first row strictly positive for p<2, verifies the entire unimodular-phase Laurent identity and 40 strictly positive Bernstein coefficients, and expands the two-pole inverse Hankel determinant to (xi eta)^3. The Schur-boundary cases p=0,p=2,gamma=-1 exhaust all equality possibilities; no finite numerical sampling is treated as proof.

value.rationale: The complete equality geometry of a recently proven sharp inverse-Hankel extremal problem is a natural classification. The optimal constant is achieved not just by the familiar Koebe rotations but by every two-pole boundary rational map, with one essential continuous parameter after rotations; proving exclusivity via exact phase positivity distinguishes genuine extremizers from non-tight Schur-boundary estimates.
